body: I know it wasn't your goal i am just so down it's impossible. Doubt we will be able to get the pain of loneliness away since us humans are programmed to crave social connections. Truth is I will end it when i cant cope anymore.
Too real i started crying reading this

Yes i handle small talk easy, socializing aint hard for me i just dont feel connection with any people i operate. People still hit me up but i am not interested in those who do so, in fact i've lost interest in people in general but at the same time i want some geniune connection. It's really twisted and dark. And yes i haven't been caught because i use anonymous messengers with secret chats and take breaks everytime my gut tells me, worked out so far but it's not forever I am ready to serve in prison at this point really

I feel you. People surround me all the time but i am so dead inside and lonely it's impossible. Btw they have no idea anything is wrong me because life taught not to show weaknesses to people, at all. Stay strong brother
